reviews.title: Hugely disappointed
reviews.body:
Hugely disappointed, i ordered the iphone duo on preorder and had it confirmed that deliver was as soon as iPhone was released on the 22nd (expect delivery next day)
I call on Saturday to be told the delivery had arrived and just needed checking into the warehouse today (monday 26th) i would then get next day delivery. I call again today (26th) and was told phones won’t be in until at least 7th november. It seems i get a differant story each time i call. 
Looking like i will cancel my order alltogether and get a refund and buy it elsewhere with a more reliable company. 
My advise is stick with Lebara for data but steer clear if you’re buying a new handset. 
Very disappointing service.
